source: Ours (dspi-unified-console, WP PGHPOL): rows for our private pages 0xE0-0xEF (PLAN-PG sections 1.3 and 1.6). Same row shape as commands-1.3.json; merged with it, never overriding one of its rows.

commands.name: EXT.TUNNEL
commands.note: 0xE010, our extension channel on paged firmware (wValue = extension id); admin only both ways, as REQ_EXTENSION 0x00 is (absent from the 1.2 table). Its GET only reads; the core-voltage rule judges its SET as 0x00's.
